title: A Thorn for the Spire
author: Ada Nakamura
blurb: Ada Nakamura, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
